articles.title: Russell Brand called a ‘ruthless’ sexual predator as rape and sexual assault trial begins in London; 51-year-old comedian pleads not guilty to three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault and one count of indecent assault
articles.summary: Russell Brand was described as a “ruthless” and manipulative sexual predator by a prosecutor as his rape and sexual assault trial began at Southwark Crown
articles.body: Russell Brand was described as a “ruthless” and manipulative sexual predator by a prosecutor as his rape and sexual assault trial began at Southwark Crown Court in London on Wednesday. According to The Associated Press, the 51-year-old actor-comedian has pleaded not guilty to three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault and one count of indecent assault involving six women. The alleged offences took place between 1999 and 2009.Opening the prosecution's case, prosecutor Riel Karmy-Jones told jurors that the six women, who did not know one another, were allegedly assaulted at different locations, including a hotel room, workplaces, a bar's toilet cubicle and Brand's home.She alleged that Brand had an “indiscriminate and voracious” desire for sexual contact at the time, adding that “women were simply a means to an end”.The prosecutor acknowledged that Brand could be funny and charming but described him as “a flirt with a huge sexual appetite — childlike in his expectation that his every desire should be met”.“He was ruthless, he was calculating, he was manipulative. And, the prosecution say, he was a sexual predator,” Karmy-Jones told the jury.Six women have made allegations spanning a decadeThe court heard details of the allegations, which span a decade. The earliest complainant alleges that Brand raped her in a hotel room in 1999, during the Labour Party's annual conference in Bournemouth, where he was performing at a fringe cabaret event.Another woman alleges that, in 2001, Brand tried to drag her into a men's bathroom at the office building where she worked.“There can be little doubt as to what Mr Brand's intention was,” Karmy-Jones said.A third woman alleges that Brand orally raped her in a London bar's restroom in 2004. According to the prosecution, when she asked him to stop, he told her, “Don't be a spoilsport.”The remaining allegations include an incident at a London radio station in 2004 or 2005, when a woman alleges that Brand kissed and groped her, leaving her feeling “dirty and disgusting”.Another complainant, who was 21 at the time, alleges that Brand anally raped her at his home in 2009 after she met him at one of his shows.The prosecutor told the court that the woman exchanged text messages with Brand the following year, telling him, “You treated me like an animal.” He allegedly replied, “I'm sorry.”The sixth complainant alleges that Brand demanded a massage and pressed his face into her groin while an advertisement was being recorded in 2009.Prosecutor explains why the women did not report the alleged assaults earlierKarmy-Jones told jurors that none of the women reported the alleged incidents to the police at the time. She said they were held back by feelings of guilt and shame, as well as concerns that they would be blamed.According to the prosecution, the women independently approached the police after a television programme broadcast anonymous allegations against Brand in 2023.The prosecutor said the jury would hear directly from the complainants during the trial, adding, “I have no doubt you will find their evidence compelling.”Former friend recounts 1999 trip to BournemouthThe first witness to testify was Mark Pinheiro, a former friend of Brand who accompanied him on the trip to Bournemouth in 1999.Pinheiro told the court that Brand made them leave the town abruptly the day after the alleged rape and appeared “incredibly alert and incredibly afraid”.“Whenever a police siren passed the car, Russell would cower down behind the side window so he couldn't be seen,” he said.Brand's lawyer, Ian Winter, questioned Pinheiro's recollection of events that allegedly took place more than 25 years ago.Brand has denied all the charges. During police interviews, he denied ever engaging in non-consensual sexual activity.Russell Brand says he feels ‘blessed’ ahead of trialBrand arrived at court on Wednesday amid a crowd of photographers and video journalists. Speaking briefly, he said he felt “blessed” and expressed hope that the legal proceedings would lead to a positive outcome.“I feel, of course, concerned but hopeful that this process will lead to good outcomes for everybody involved,” he said. “That's my prayer.”Known for his risque stand-up comedy and highly publicised struggles with drugs and alcohol, Brand rose to prominence in the early 2000s. He hosted television programmes and a BBC radio show before appearing in Hollywood films such as ‘Forgetting Sarah Marshall’ and ‘Get Him to the Greek’. He was also briefly married to pop star Katy Perry.In recent years, Brand has moved away from mainstream media, relocated to Florida and built a substantial online following through videos discussing wellness, conspiracy theories and his religious beliefs.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: ‘New Girl’ star Jake Johnson lists $3.295 million Pasadena home with a pool, sauna-equipped sunroom and two detached structures
articles.summary: Actor Jake Johnson, best known for playing Nick Miller on New Girl and co-hosting the comedy podcast We’re Here to Help, has listed a Pasadena,
articles.body: Actor Jake Johnson, best known for playing Nick Miller on New Girl and co-hosting the comedy podcast We’re Here to Help, has listed a Pasadena, California, home for $3.295 million. The contemporary-style residence has 3,153 square feet of living space, 4 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms, and sits behind private gates on a lot of nearly half an acre, according to published reports. Its features include a swimming pool, landscaped grounds, 2 detached structures and a sunroom with a sauna. Thomas Atamian of Coldwell Banker Realty is handling the listing. The home was built in 1947 and remodelled in 2004 by architect Aleks Istanbullu, according to the listing details reported by the media. Whether the home sells at its $3.295 million asking price remains to be seen, but its gated privacy, pool, sauna-equipped sunroom and flexible detached studios give it broad appeal for buyers seeking a creative, wellness-oriented Pasadena retreat.Jake Johnson’s Pasadena home listing: what $3.295 million buysThe home combines a contemporary interior with extensive outdoor space. Reports describing the listing mention hardwood floors, wood accents, large windows and open living and dining areas that look out towards the grounds. The property sits behind private gates, with mature landscaping helping to screen it from the street. The grounds include a swimming pool, outdoor areas for relaxing and dining, and a garden featuring California native plants and fruit trees, according to published descriptions. Listing agent Thomas Atamian has emphasised the property’s privacy and the flexibility offered by its additional structures.The asking price is $3.295 million, although some media reports round it to $3.3 million or $3.29 million. These are rounded versions of the same asking price, rather than evidence of separate listings. The property’s appeal rests on its combination of indoor living space, outdoor grounds and additional buildings.Sunroom sauna and spa-inspired bathroom: inside the primary suiteThe primary suite includes a vaulted ceiling, a fireplace and a walk-in closet. The adjoining bathroom features Italian blue glass mosaic tile around a soaking tub and a separate shower, according to descriptions of the listing. A sunroom equipped with a sauna is another feature of the property. The sunroom and sauna are part of the home’s wellness-focused amenities, but descriptions of the layout should be read carefully because reports do not always distinguish clearly between the sunroom and the detached wellness structure. The listing photographs, credited to Hillary Campbell and supplied by Coldwell Banker, show the primary suite, bathroom, sunroom and other interior spaces.The house has also served as a place for Johnson’s creative work. The Pasadena Star-News reported that the walk-in closet had previously been used as a creative space for his comedy podcast, We’re Here to Help. The detail offers a glimpse of how the property has been used beyond its role as a residence.Two detached structures and a creative pastThe 2 detached structures add flexible space beyond the main house. According to the listing description quoted in media reports, they can accommodate uses such as working from home, creative projects and wellness activities. Their layout and previous uses are more specific than the general description of two additional studios might suggest. In a 2023 interview with The Hollywood Reporter, Johnson described using one of the structures as a creative escape for his projects and another as a wellness space with an adjoining sunroom. That account provides context for the buildings’ previous uses, although it should not be taken as confirmation of their permitted uses or current configuration.The listing identifies the property as a contemporary architectural residence remodelled by Aleks Istanbullu in 2004. Public-record reporting has also raised a distinction between the listing’s association with Johnson and the name on the property title. The property has been reported as held by the Poppy Lou Trust, which acquired it for $2.215 million in April 2017. That purchase price is a historical figure, not the current asking price, and the trust’s ownership should not be presented as proof that Johnson personally holds title. The current listing brings together a gated setting, landscaped grounds, a pool, a sauna-equipped sunroom and two detached structures. Its asking price is $3.295 million, but the property’s eventual sale price, if sold, may differ from that figure.Ready to Make a Smarter Property Decision? Build Your Legacy with TOI Homes.

articles.title: ‘Only Modi can tour’: Mann slams Paris denial after Japan
articles.summary: Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann slams Centre/MEA for denying clearance to visit SIAL Paris food festival; cites repeated rejections, calls it political bias.
articles.body: CHANDIGARH: Punjab chief minister Bhagwant Mann on Thursday criticised the Centre for denying him political clearance to visit Paris, where he has been invited to attend a food festival featuring a Markfed exhibition stall.Replying to a question, Mann told media in New Delhi, “What do we do? There is a food festival being held in Paris, and we received an invitation from the French govt, with Markfed putting up a stall. Earlier, I was also scheduled to travel to Japan for three days to watch the semi-finals and finals of the hockey matches. Since we are hosting the Men’s Hockey Asian Champions Trophy starting Oct 27, we also wanted to extend a formal invitation to them in person.”Hitting out at the Narendra Modi-led Centre, Mann added, “They simply refuse to give me permission (to travel abroad). It seems as though only PM Modi can tour the world—visiting even the most obscure places like Papua Guinea, ‘Manglesia,’ or ‘Changlesia.’ We have now moved the high court, and I hope to receive approval tomorrow. Our goal in traveling is strictly to benefit Punjab, attracting investors so we can create employment opportunities for our youth.”The food festival in question refers to SIAL Paris, touted as the world’s largest and most influential food innovation exhibition and trade fair held biennially at Paris Nord Villepinte exhibition centre.This is not an isolated incident, as CM Mann and his members have repeatedly been denied political clearance by the ministry of external affairs (MEA) for foreign visits. In Aug 2024, the Centre blocked Mann’s proposed trip to Paris to attend the Olympics and cheer on the Indian men’s hockey team, citing diplomatic and administrative reasons.Prior to this, Mann and then-industries minister Sanjeev Arora were denied approval for a planned investment outreach tour to the UK and Israel ahead of Progressive Punjab Investors’ Summit. More recently, MEA refused him clearance to travel to Japan for the Asian Games hockey semi-finals on security grounds.In Sept 2022, Punjab minister Aman Arora was refused approval for an official knowledge-sharing tour to Germany, Belgium, and the Netherlands. Also, assembly speaker Kultar Singh Sandhwan was denied clearance to attend a legislative speakers’ conference in the US in Aug 2024. Minister Harbhajan Singh was blocked from representing Punjab’s governance model at a conference in Boston in Aug last year.Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) leadership has termed these rejections politically motivated, alleging partisan political discrimination by the Centre toward Punjab.In contrast, neighbouring Haryana’s chief minister Nayab Singh Saini has consistently been granted prompt political clearances for his international delegations and investment tours. Recently, Saini led a high-level state delegation on a three-day official visit to Singapore from Oct 4 to Oct 6 to pitch investment, urban infrastructure, and trade partnerships. articles.title: Veja o que fazer em SP: 50ª Mostra de Cinema, Viradinha, shows de Pitty e Barão Vermelho, Baile da Pocah e festival árabe | G1

articles.summary: Tem também muitas opções gratuitas para curtir a cidade: como a 8ª Parada LGBTQIA+ do Itaim Paulista, e o Festival Cartografias de Bamba na Barra Funda.
articles.body:
Pitty se apresenta no Rock in Rio 2024 — Foto: Stephanie Rodrigues/g1

A cidade de São Paulo tem um fim de semana de programação intensa, com a 50ª Mostra Internacional de Cinema, que reúne 380 filmes de 93 países até 29 de outubro, e a Viradinha 2026, festival infantil gratuito com mais de 400 atividades espalhadas por todas as regiões da capital. Para quem prefere música ao vivo, a agenda inclui Pitty, Barão Vermelho, Rashid, Jorge Vercillo e Dionne Warwick, que apresenta sua turnê de despedida na cidade.

O fim de semana também tem opções gratuitas para curtir a cidade: a 8ª Parada LGBTQIA+ do Itaim Paulista reúne shows e atividades culturais na Zona Leste, enquanto o Festival Cartografias de Bamba ocupa a Rua do Samba da Barra Funda com apresentações musicais, batalha de rima, literatura e gastronomia. No Parque Ceret, no Tatuapé, o 1º Festival de Comida Árabe da Zona Leste reúne mais de 40 expositores, além de atrações culturais e atividades para toda a família.

No teatro, a programação vai de clássicos infantis, como “João e o Pé de Feijão”, a montagens que misturam música e literatura, como o encontro entre o maestro João Carlos Martins e o escritor Gabriel Chalita. Há ainda concertos gratuitos da OCAM-ECA/USP com a obra de Mahler e apresentações para crianças, como “Planeta Peteca”, de Cris Barulins. Para quem gosta de cinema ao ar livre, o Centro Cultural São Paulo recebe uma sessão de “It: A Coisa” com música ao vivo, enquanto o BikeCine exibe filmes com energia gerada pelas pedaladas do público.

50ª Mostra Internacional de Cinema de São Paulo

Coletiva de imprensa da 50ª Mostra Internacional de Cinema em São Paulo — Foto: Mario Miranda Filho/Agência Foto

A 50ª Mostra Internacional de Cinema de São Paulo reúne 380 filmes de 93 países até 29 de outubro, em sessões espalhadas por 57 salas de cinema, espaços culturais e CEUs da capital. A programação começa nesta quinta-feira (15) e inclui mais de 100 produções brasileiras, além da terceira edição da Mostrinha, voltada ao público infantil.

Um dos destaques desta edição comemorativa é o cineasta norte-americano James Gray, responsável pela arte do cartaz do festival. Ele participa da abertura para apresentar Tigre de Papel (Paper Tiger), seu novo filme, que também terá sessões comerciais durante a Mostra. A programação reúne produções de diferentes países e gêneros, com opções para públicos variados.

📍 Onde? Em 57 salas de cinema, espaços culturais e CEUs de São Paulo

💲 Quanto? De segunda a quinta-feira: R$ 26 (inteira) e R$ 13 (meia-entrada). De sexta a domingo: R$ 32 (inteira) e R$ 16 (meia-entrada)

”Vaqueiro Benedito e a Cobra Caninana” junta teatro com forró na Biblioteca Mário de Andrade — Foto: Divulgação

Palhaços, acrobatas, malabaristas e contação de histórias estão entre as atrações da Viradinha 2026, festival infantil gratuito que acontece de sexta-feira (16) a domingo (18), em todas as regiões de São Paulo. Em sua segunda edição, o evento reúne mais de 400 atividades para crianças, com espetáculos, oficinas criativas e shows musicais.

A programação circense inclui atrações como “PixuShow”, do Circo Bem Bolado, “As Charlatonas”, da Trupe Açu, e apresentações do Circo do Asfalto, que celebra 20 anos de trajetória. Há também espetáculos para bebês e crianças pequenas, como “Broto de Circo”, da Trupe Germinar. As atividades acontecem em espaços culturais da cidade, com horários variados.

📅 Quando? De sexta-feira (16) a domingo (18), em horários variados

📍 Onde? Em espaços culturais de todas as regiões de São Paulo

6ª Parada do Orgulho LGBTQIA+ de Itaim Paulista — Foto: Reprodução/Paulo Neobeck

A Zona Leste de São Paulo recebe neste domingo (18) a 8ª Parada LGBTQIA+ do Itaim Paulista, com shows, feira de empreendedorismo e atividades que celebram a diversidade e a cultura periférica. Com o tema “Parada 2.0”, a iniciativa busca fortalecer a comunidade LGBTQIA+ da região, ampliar a visibilidade de artistas locais e incentivar pequenos empreendedores.

📍 Onde? Rua Monte Camberela, 490, Vila Silva Teles (Zona Leste)

Pitty estreia a turnê de seu sexto álbum de inéditas, “PITTY”, lançado após sete anos sem um disco de inéditas. O show combina as novas músicas com sucessos da carreira em um espetáculo que aposta na energia do rock ao vivo, alternando momentos de peso, movimento e maior intimidade com o público. A primeira etapa da turnê prevê apresentações em dez cidades entre outubro e dezembro de 2026.

📅 Quando? 17 de outubro, sábado. Abertura dos portões às 20h30 e show às 22h30

📍 Onde? Espaço Unimed, Rua Tagipuru, 795, Barra Funda, Zona Oeste

1º Festival de Comida Árabe da Zona Leste no Ceret

1º Festival de Comida Árabe da Zona Leste reúne gastronomia, shows e feira de adoção no CERET — Foto: Reprodução

O evento reúne mais de 40 expositores de gastronomia árabe, com opções como shawarmas, kebabs, falafel, esfirras, doces tradicionais e sucos. A programação também inclui apresentações culturais, workshop gratuito de dança do ventre, festival de fatias de bolo, espaço infantil e feira de adoção de cães e gatos em parceria com a ONG Vira Lata Club. A adoção é gratuita, e o público pode contribuir com doações de ração e medicamentos. O evento é pet friendly.

📅 Quando? Sábado (17) e domingo (18), das 10h às 20h. O workshop de dança do ventre acontece no sábado, às 13h

📍 Onde: Parque Ceret | Rua Canuto Abreu, Tatuapé, Zona Leste

Barão Vermelho se apresenta no Rock in Rio 2026 — Foto: Leo Franco/AgNews

Os fãs do Barão Vermelho poderão reviver clássicos do rock nacional na turnê “Barão Vermelho Encontro”, que reúne integrantes da formação original: Roberto Frejat, Guto Goffi, Mauricio Barros e Dé Palmeira. O guitarrista Fernando Magalhães participa como convidado especial. O repertório percorre diferentes fases do grupo e inclui sucessos como “Bete Balanço”, “Pro Dia Nascer Feliz”, “Por Você”, “Maior Abandonado” e “Puro Êxtase”.

📍 Onde? Espaço Unimed | Rua Tagipuru, 795, Barra Funda (Zona Oeste)

💲 Quanto? Ingressos a partir de R$ 132,50 (meia-entrada)

Rincón Sapiência, samba e batalha de rima

Rincón Sapiência e Pagode na Lata estão entre as atrações do Festival Cartografias de Bamba, que ocupa a Rua do Samba da Barra Funda neste domingo (18). A programação gratuita reúne música, literatura, rodas de conversa e feira de gastronomia e economia criativa.

Com o tema “Cultura, Memória e Cuidado”, a edição especial também celebra a história do samba paulistano. Um dos destaques será o ensaio aberto da Mocidade Unidos da Mooca, que apresentará um enredo em homenagem a cinco nomes históricos do samba de São Paulo. O público também poderá acompanhar o Sarau no Kintal, com o poeta Akins Kintê e o escritor Hamilton Borges.

📅 Quando? Domingo (18), das 10h30 às 22h

📍 Onde? Rua do Samba da Barra Funda, em frente ao Bar do Chagas, Barra Funda (Zona Oeste)

Pocah celebra aniversário com estreia da turnê “Baile da Pocah” em São Paulo — Foto: Divulgação

A cantora Pocah comemora seu aniversário nesta sexta-feira, 16 de outubro de 2026, com uma festa especial na Audio, em São Paulo. O evento também marca a estreia da turnê “Baile da Pocah”, projeto que celebra a trajetória da artista no funk brasileiro e reúne sucessos de sua carreira.

A programação começa às 22h e segue até as 6h. Além do show de Pocah, a noite terá sets dos DJs Shanaya, Yu Engel, Diego Martins, Vinny Benincasa e Alvye, com música e dança em uma festa dedicada ao funk.

📅 Quando? Sexta-feira (16), das 22h às 6h

📍 Onde? Audio | Avenida Francisco Matarazzo, 694, Água Branca (Zona Oeste)

Contra.Cena — Foto: Reprodução/Instagram

O Contra.Cena reúne música, DJs e experiências em uma noite na Casa Rockambole , na Vila Madalena, Zona Oeste de São Paulo. O evento acontece em 16 de outubro e promete reunir o público em uma programação voltada à música e à conexão entre pessoas. A lineup conta com apresentações de Sislop, Infinito Latente, Celacanto, Morro-Fuji e Flerte Flamingo. A programação também terá DJ sets de Caco/Concha, Cavaca Records e Digital Fate. Os ingressos estão à venda.

📅 Quando? Sexta-feira (16), das 21h às 3h

📍 Onde? Casa Rockambole | Rua Belmiro Braga, 119 - Vila Madalena (Zona Oeste)

Dionne Warwick se despede dos palcos com turnê em São Paulo

A cantora americana Dionne Warwick apresenta a turnê de despedida “Over and Out: A Farewell Tour”, com um repertório que reúne clássicos de sua carreira, como “That’s What Friends Are For”, “I Say a Little Prayer”, “Heartbreaker” e “I’ll Never Love This Way Again”. Seis vezes vencedora do Grammy, a artista vendeu mais de 100 milhões de discos ao longo da trajetória.

📅 Quando? 16 de outubro, sexta-feira. Abertura dos portões às 19h e show às 21h

📍 Onde? Vibra São Paulo | Avenida das Nações Unidas, 17.955, Vila Almeida, Zona Sul

Rashid apresenta a CUMULONIMBUS TOUR na Casa Natura Musical

Rashid em estúdio durante entrevista ao g1. — Foto: Rafael Peixoto/g1

Rashid apresenta ao vivo as faixas de “CUMULONIMBUS”, seu sexto álbum de estúdio, além de sucessos da carreira. O disco, lançado em agosto, acumula quase 4 milhões de reproduções nas plataformas digitais e aborda inquietações, memórias e reflexões do artista sobre o rap e seu tempo. A turnê estreou em setembro, com ingressos esgotados no Sesc Belenzinho, e leva ao palco a atmosfera do álbum, com beats, rimas e referências à cultura hip-hop.

📍 Onde? Casa Natura Musical, Rua Artur de Azevedo, 2.134, Pinheiros, Zona Oeste

Jorge Vercillo é atração do Festival Equinócio da Primavera em Macapá — Foto: Divulgação

Jorge Vercillo apresenta o espetáculo “JV30 Parte II – Mais um final feliz”, que dá continuidade à turnê comemorativa de seus 30 anos de carreira. Com direção de Rafael Dragaud, o show reúne sucessos como “Que Nem Maré”, “Fênix”, “Homem-Aranha”, “Monalisa” e “Final Feliz”, além de canções mais recentes. O repertório percorre diferentes gêneros, como bossa nova, ijexá, samba, R&B, reggae e jazz.

📍 Onde: Tokio Marine Hall | R. Bragança Paulista, 1.281 - Várzea de Baixo, Zona Sul

O rooftop da Galeria do Rock recebe uma programação especial dedicada aos fãs do rock — Foto: Divulgação

O rooftop da Galeria do Rock, no Centro Histórico de São Paulo, recebe neste sábado, 17 de outubro de 2026, uma programação especial para os fãs de rock. O evento reúne apresentações de duas bandas tributo a nomes marcantes do hard rock: AC/DC e Van Halen.

A programação começa ao meio-dia, com a abertura da casa. Às 14h, a banda Dirty Jack sobe ao palco com clássicos do AC/DC. Em seguida, às 16h30, é a vez da Balance homenagear o Van Halen com grandes sucessos do grupo. O encerramento está previsto para as 19h.

📍 Onde? Rooftop da Galeria do Rock | Avenida São João, 439, Centro Histórico

Cê Tá Doido Festival reúne Ícaro & Gilmar, Panda e Humberto & Ronaldo em SP

Cê Tá Doido Festival reúne Ícaro & Gilmar, Panda e Humberto & Ronaldo em SP — Foto: Divulgação

O Cê Tá Doido Festival reúne Ícaro & Gilmar, Panda e Humberto & Ronaldo em um espetáculo com palco 360º inspirado em um posto de combustíveis, cenário da gravação que deu origem ao projeto. Com mais de quatro horas de música, os artistas dividem o palco, interpretam sucessos uns dos outros e revisitam clássicos do sertanejo, do pagode, da MPB e do pop rock. O festival já realizou mais de 40 edições pelo Brasil e acumula mais de 200 milhões de visualizações no YouTube.

📍 Onde: Distrito Anhembi | Av. Olavo Fontoura, 1.209 - Santana, Zona Norte

Maestro João Carlos Martins antes de embarcar para os Estados Unidos — Foto: Fábio Tito/g1

O maestro João Carlos Martins e o escritor Gabriel Chalita se encontram no palco do Teatro Faap para um espetáculo que mistura música clássica e literatura. A apresentação propõe um diálogo entre composições de nomes como Bach, Chopin, Schubert, Morricone e Ginastera e textos de autores como Clarice Lispector, Fernando Pessoa, Cora Coralina e Manoel de Barros.

📅 Quando? Quartas e quintas-feiras, às 20h, até 22 de outubro

📍 Onde? Teatro Faap | Rua Alagoas, 903, Higienópolis (Zona Oeste)

💲 Quanto? Plateia: R$ 120 (inteira) e R$ 60 (meia-entrada); mezanino: R$ 90 (inteira) e R$ 45 (meia-entrada)

Festival Chopin 2026: Mateusz Krzyżowski e Quinteto São Paulo Chamber Soloists

O Festival Chopin 2026 apresenta o pianista polonês Mateusz Krzyżowski no sábado, 17 de outubro, às 20h30, no Teatro Cultura Artística, em São Paulo. Reconhecido por sua técnica refinada e expressividade, o músico é premiado em importantes concursos internacionais e integra a programação da 5ª edição do festival, dedicado à obra de Frédéric Chopin e à música erudita.

📍 Onde? Teatro Cultura Artística | Rua Nestor Pestana, 196 (Centro)

Musical João e o Pé de Feijão em SP — Foto: Divulgação

Inspirado no clássico conto infantil, o espetáculo acompanha as aventuras de João, que encontra feijões mágicos e chega a um mundo de fantasia. A montagem reúne cenas divertidas, personagens marcantes e efeitos visuais, em uma experiência voltada para toda a família. A peça é recomendada para crianças a partir de 2 anos e tem duração de 50 minutos.

📍 Onde? Teatro UOL/Shopping Pátio Higienópolis | Avenida Higienópolis (Centro)

Conhecido nas redes sociais como Tio Paulo, Paulo Bonavides estreia no teatro com a comédia musical “Entre Portas e Perrengues”, no dia 17 de outubro de 2026, no Teatro Bradesco, em São Paulo. articles.title: Spice Girls: clipe de 'Wannabe' faz 30 anos e esconde corte | G1
articles.standfirst: Vídeo foi gravado em hotel abandonado em Londres depois que a locação original, em Barcelona, teve a autorização negada. VÍDEO mostra curiosidades do 1º clipe gravado pela girl band.
articles.summary: O clipe de 'Wannabe' das Spice Girls completa 30 anos revelando um corte escondido e bastidores curiosos em um hotel abandonado de Londres.
articles.body:
Há 30 anos, as Spice Girls lançavam o primeiro clipe do quinteto, “Wannabe”. O vídeo é lembrado como um plano-sequência, filmado sem cortes. Na prática, há uma emenda, que seria aos 2 minutos e 46 segundos de vídeo, embora não confirmada pela equipe que criou o vídeo.

A ideia era gravar em um prédio em Barcelona, com as cantoras invadindo uma festa. Cinco dias antes das filmagens, a autorização foi negada. A produção levou o clipe ao St. Pancras Renaissance Hotel (antigo Midland Grand Hotel), que estava abandonado no centro de Londres. Por lá, fazia muito frio e havia pouca iluminação.

O resultado parece espontâneo, mas boa parte do que surge na tela foi coreografada. O grupo repetiu o trajeto várias vezes antes de começar a gravar, e a equipe fez de 10 a 15 gravações completas .

Na edição, o diretor uniu a primeira metade impecável de um take à segunda metade de outro. A emenda parece estar escondida no momento em que a câmera mostra uma TV exibindo o clipe.

Alguns takes foram descartados, incluindo os que Geri Halliwell tropeçou e caiu porque estava de salto alto.

As Spice Girls no clipe de 'Wannabe', de 1996 — Foto: Reprodução

A direção é do sueco Johan Camitz, que nunca tinha feito um clipe. Quatro anos depois, ele morreu em um acidente ao ser atropelado por um motorista que havia sido baleado.

Antes do sucesso, o vídeo enfrentou resistência. Executivos da gravadora Virgin consideraram a música e o clipe estranhos e anárquicos demais. A preocupação aumentou porque rádios como a BBC 1 se recusaram a tocar a música assim que ela foi lançada.

Os executivos também acharam as roupas das cantoras justas e transparentes demais. Chegaram a querer que o clipe fosse regravado, mas desistiram da ideia.

Meses depois, “Wannabe” passou a ser exibido na TV inglesa e entrou na programação da MTV. A música ficou um mês no topo da Hot 100 da "Billboard" e se tornou o primeiro hit das Spice Girls.

articles.title: 'Jailer 2' OTT release date: When and where can we expect the Rajinikanth starrer online
articles.summary: Rajinikanth’s 'Jailer 2' has opened strongly at the box office, raising hopes for another hit for the superstar.
articles.body: Rajinikanth’s 'Jailer 2' has opened strongly at the box office, raising hopes for another hit for the superstar. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, the film sees Rajinikanth return as Muthuvel Pandian, also known as Tiger. The action scenes, star cast, and mass moments have caught the attention of fans. Meanwhile, the OTT lovers are keen to know details about the film's streaming partner and expected OTT release date.Amazon Prime Video to stream 'Jailer 2'As per the official announcement, Amazon Prime Video has acquired the digital streaming rights to 'Jailer 2.' As per Hindustan Times, the deal was locked for Rs 160 crore, and the film is expected to premiere on the platform on November 12, 2026. The deal includes a four-week theatrical window, meaning the Rajinikanth-starrer is expected to arrive online around a month after its cinema release. The anticipated OTT premiere will give fans, who missed the film on the big screen, an opportunity to watch it at their comfort. However, the streaming date has yet to receive official confirmation from Amazon Prime Video or the makers, and November 12 should therefore be considered a tentative date.'Jailer 2' cast and crewThe sequel to the 2023 blockbuster 'Jailer' features a star-studded ensemble led by Rajinikanth. The cast includes Ramya Krishnan, Yogi Babu, Mithun Chakraborty, Mohanlal, and Shivarajkumar, among others. Nelson Dilipkumar returns as director, while Sun Pictures backs the ambitious project. Anirudh Ravichander has composed the music, adding to the anticipation surrounding the film’s soundtrack and action-packed sequences. The movie’s star-studded cast, with actors from different industries has helped it reach beyond the shores of Tamil Nadu and make a good start.Will 'Jailer 2' be able to continue its streak?'Jailer 2' has been receiving good reviews and feedback from viewers. Rajinikanth’s performance, the action scenes, and Nelson’s direction have caught viewers’ attention. According to Sacnilk, the film has reportedly collected over Rs 120 crore worldwide on Day 1. Its performance in the coming days will show whether it can match or beat the box office success of the first film.The expected Amazon Prime Video release has also created interest among fans. ‘Jailer 2’ has made an excellent start with its positive response, and it is sure to stay a hot topic throughout its theatrical run before its expected OTT release.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Vicente Vallés cuestiona el uso de la Diputación Permanente por parte del Gobierno para intentar aprobar los decretos de vivienda: “Trampeo político”
articles.standfirst: El presentador de 'Antena 3 Noticias 2' cerró la semana en ‘El Hormiguero’
articles.summary: El presentador de 'Antena 3 Noticias 2' cerró la semana en ‘El Hormiguero’
articles.body: Este jueves, 15 de octubre, ‘El Hormiguero’, programa que presenta y dirige Pablo Motos en el ‘access prime time’ de Antena 3, cerró una nueva semana con la visita de Vicente Vallés, reconocido periodista de nuestro país y presentador de ‘Antena 3 Noticias 2’. El presentador acudió al espacio de Atresmedia para presentar ‘Espías: clave secreta’, su serie documental de historia y espionaje disponible en Onda Cero. Así le presentó Motos: “Él viene de aquí al lado, le tenemos controlado por el GPS y ya ha llegado. Es invitado platino, una ovación para él”. Vallés entró en un BMW por todo lo alto al plató entre aplausos y vítores del público, agradeciendo el televisivo la calurosa bienvenida. El presentador de ‘El Hormiguero’ se interesó por la obra del invitado, que había sido escrita, narrada y dirigida por él. “A los espías les hubiera gustado ser periodistas y a los espías, periodistas. Ambos tienen similitudes, nos queremos enterar de cosas que nadie conoce. Un espía cuando conoce algo se lo comunica a personas importantes para que tomen decisiones y los periodistas salimos a contarlos corriendo”, contestó Vicente Vallés. “No sería un buen espía, por eso me dedico al periodista”, añadió Vallés entre risas. Posteriormente, charlaron de varios entresijos de la citada obra del comunicador de ‘Antena 3 Noticias 2’. “Me fascinan los espías ilegales, que los forman, los mandan a un país, tienen pareja, hijos y los activan. Es un argumento espectacular en una película”, apostilló Motos, visiblemente impresionado tras escuchar la trama de ‘Espías: clave secreta’. En este sentido, el comunicador de Requena quedó impresionado al comprobar de primera mano que los espías de la obra de Vallés mantienen la “intriga” en todo momento: “Su vida siempre está en juego, puede pasar cualquier cosa en cualquier momento. Pueden ser detenidos a las cinco de la mañana porque los han descubierto o alguien de su departamento se pasa al enemigo y los delata”, añadió el presentador de noticias al respecto. “Desde que empecé a escribir e informarme de estos temas, decidí desconectar, porque si no, no lo haces. Pensarías todo el rato”, afirmó Vicente Vallés acerca de la intriga que le causó componer su obra por todas las preguntas que plantea. Tras ello, llegó el momento de hablar de los mejores servicios secretos del mundo, saliendo a escena el CNI y su gestión en la crisis de Ceuta: “Es muy negativo tirar piedras contra el tejado de tus propios servicios de inteligencia. Visto con la perspectiva de los dos meses y pico que han pasado, da la sensación de que la imagen del CNI ha salido reforzada y la del Gobierno, perjudicada. Ha sido un intento del Gobierno de salvarse a sí mismo”, recalcó Vallés. Con lo que respecta a las consecuencias judiciales por lo sucedido en Ceuta dijo que irá por “mucho tiempo”, pero que es “firme” cuando actúa. Asimismo, Vicente Vallés dijo que la ciudadanía merecía saber que una fragata marroquí había estado en aguas ceutíes justo cuando se produjo el asalto y no “ocultarlo”. Otro de los temas es el adelanto electoral por parte de Pedro Sánchez, presidente del Gobierno, al 29N, algo que llevó a Motos a cuestionarle sobre si habrá debate electoral en Antena 3, a lo que contestó el invitado. “Esperemos que sí. Dependemos de los partidos políticos”. Llegando al tramo final de la entrevista, Motos le preguntó sobre los dos decretos de la vivienda y el uso de la Diputación Permanente por parte del Ejecutivo actual para intentar aprobarlos de cara a paliar la crisis, algo de lo que se pronunció de manera tajante: “Hay quien dice que es legal, pero es un trampeo político. Un decreto rechazado por el pleno no debería ser aprobado por un organismo cuyos miembros no representan la misma composición de diputados que el pleno del Congreso. Cuando te dicen que no, es que no. Habría que esperar a las elecciones”. El problema cree que se solucionará en un “periodo largo de tiempo”, pero que no sabe cuál es la solución. Ante este tipo de adversidades pidió unidad a todas las formaciones políticas de España: “En los grandes asuntos de Estado, los partidos tienen que entenderse”. Por último, ante las acusaciones de fraude electoral ante el voto por correo de cara al 29N por parte de Ayuso, Feijóo y Abascal, Vallés lo tiene claro: “Hay que tener algunas pruebas para demostrarlo y no basarse solo en sospechas. Hay mucha gente que considera que ya se ha producido un fraude que todavía no ha ocurrido”.

articles.title: ‘One of the biggest challenges of riding is people’s perception’: Fatima Sana Shaikh
articles.summary: For Fatima Sana Shaikh, biking is more than a thrill, it is a meditative experience that offers a sense of freedom and perspective.
articles.body: For Fatima Sana Shaikh, biking is more than a thrill, it is a meditative experience that offers a sense of freedom and perspective. The actress, whose film Dhak Dhak took her through the challenging terrains of Ladakh and Himachal Pradesh, recently bought a new bike that she got customised. The actress says riding has taught her as much about endurance as it has about the joy of the open road.In an exclusive interview with us, she also calls out the gender stereotypes and harassment women riders continue to face, arguing that riding a motorcycle should not be seen as extraordinary simply because the rider is a woman.What sparked your love for biking, and what does being on a bike give you that you don’t experience in any other aspect of your life? Is it the sense of freedom, the thrill of the open road or the feeling of being completely in the moment?I don’t remember the exact moment I fell in love with biking. But as a child, my father would take me along for a short ride on his bike every evening. So, for me, bikes have always been associated with happiness and excitement. In fact, my father was also the first person who taught me how to ride. Riding is such a beautiful feeling. It’s very liberating. I don’t know how to explain it exactly, but there’s something incredible about being able to control a machine that almost becomes an extension of your body. Even the slightest shift in your body weight can change the direction of the bike. I find that fascinating. And especially when you’re riding in the mountains, it’s such a humbling experience. You realise how small and insignificant you are in the larger scheme of things. You feel the temperature dropping, the wind, the changing landscape. You’re experiencing everything around you rather than just watching it go by. I find riding very meditative.What has been the most memorable or rewarding part of your biking journey so far? Is there a particular ride, destination or experience that made you fall in love with biking all over again?I think it was when I was shooting for Dhak Dhak. I got to ride in Ladakh and Himachal Pradesh, and honestly, I don’t think I would have ever dared to ride in the mountains otherwise. But shooting for that film and riding through those terrains made me realise that biking isn’t just about the fun and excitement. It’s tough. Especially when you’re riding long distances or touring. It’s physically and emotionally demanding, and I got a taste of that during the shoot. But it also made me realise how rewarding the experience can be. And ever since then, I’ve wanted to do a proper bike trip on my own. Hopefully, I’ll get to do that soon.Biking comes with its share of challenges, especially for women riders. What have been some of the biggest hurdles you’ve faced on the road, and how have these experiences shaped you as a rider?One of the biggest challenges is people’s perception. We’re so used to associating bikes with men, so when a woman rides one, it suddenly becomes this extraordinary thing. And honestly, that’s kind of ridiculous, because at the end of the day, it’s just a vehicle. You learn, you practice, you get better. Just like anything else. But what really troubles me is that sometimes it doesn’t stop at perception. We’ve seen instances of women riders being pushed, intimidated, harassed on the road. It’s almost as if the audacity of a woman riding is so upsetting to some people that they’d rather harass her than just let her be. And that is really sad. I think we need to stop attaching gender to something as basic as riding a vehicle. I don’t ride to prove a point. I ride because I enjoy it. I just hope we get to a point where seeing a woman on a motorcycle is just as normal as seeing a man.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: 'Hope' actor Jung Ho-yeon calls ‘3 Idiots’ an inspiration; praises the joy in Hindi films: 'They are really about joyfulness'
articles.summary: South Korean actor Jung Ho-yeon has spoken about her appreciation for Indian cinema, naming Aamir Khan’s ‘3 Idiots’ as a film that continues to resonate
articles.body: South Korean actor Jung Ho-yeon has spoken about her appreciation for Indian cinema, naming Aamir Khan’s ‘3 Idiots’ as a film that continues to resonate with her. The actor believes Hindi films have a distinctive ability to celebrate happiness and bring joy to audiences. She also hopes to create something that leaves viewers with a similar sense of positivity.In a conversation with Variety India, Jung Ho-yeon discussed the qualities she admires in Hindi cinema. She recalled watching ‘3 Idiots’ and explained why its approach to storytelling appealed to her. The actor also shared her desire to work on a project that makes people happy.Jung Ho-yeon recalls watching ‘3 Idiots’Jung Ho-yeon praised the emotional quality she associates with Indian films, particularly their emphasis on happiness. She said she wants to explore stories that can offer audiences the same kind of joy. “I watched ‘3 Idiots’, and I always love that about Hindi films. They are really about happiness. They are really about joyfulness. I truly want to do something that makes people happy and brings joy,” Ho-yeon said.Why Aamir Khan’s ‘3 Idiots’ remains memorableReleased in 2009, ‘3 Idiots’ was directed by Rajkumar Hirani and starred Aamir Khan, R Madhavan, Sharman Joshi and Kareena Kapoor Khan. The film follows three friends whose experiences challenge conventional ideas about education, success and personal fulfillment. Through comedy and friendship, the story examines the pressure students face to meet academic expectations. It also questions an education system that often places achievement above individual interests and creativity.Jung Ho-yeon looks forward to ‘Hope’The actor is also anticipating the Indian theatrical release of ‘Hope’, a science fiction thriller written, directed and co-produced by South Korean filmmaker Na Hong-jin. The project brings together performers from South Korea and Hollywood. The ensemble cast includes Hwang Jung-min, Zo In-sung, Jung Ho-yeon, Taylor Russell, Cameron Britton, Alicia Vikander and Michael Fassbender.What is ‘Hope’ about?‘Hope’ follows a village police chief and his rookie deputy as they try to protect their community from a mysterious creature. Their efforts unfold as a hunting party in the surrounding mountains encounters a threat of its own. The film blends science fiction with monster-movie elements, placing a small community at the center of an extraordinary situation. Its story moves between familiar rural surroundings and an increasingly dangerous mystery. The movie is getting good reviews from the critics.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Karthik Subbaraj and 'Dorothy' team meet Minister Vanni Arasu over transphobia, seeks strict action and dedicated helpline for transgender community
articles.summary: Director Karthik Subbaraj’s latest film 'Dorothy' has drawn attention for its portrayal of transgender lives and social issues.
articles.body: Director Karthik Subbaraj’s latest film 'Dorothy' has drawn attention for its portrayal of transgender lives and social issues. The film, which stars Keerthy Suresh, Rishikanth and Sananth, was released on September 25. Karthik Subbaraj also produced the project, while Ilaiyaraaja composed the music for the film.Minister Vanni Arasu promises action on transgender community’s concernsThe 'Dorothy' team recently met Tamil Nadu Social Justice Minister Vanni Arasu at the state government secretariat. The minister praised the film for starting an important conversation about social change and challenging caste-based discrimination. During the meeting, Karthik Subbaraj also requested stricter rules and action against transphobia, along with a dedicated helpline for the transgender community. According to the director, the minister agreed to take up these requests. Vanni Arasu also spoke about the need for more films that question social barriers and promote equality.Karthik Subbaraj shares details of 'Dorothy' team’s meetingSharing pictures from the meeting on X, Karthik Subbaraj thanked the minister for recognising the film’s message. He wrote, “Honourable Minister Mr.Vanni Arasu sir felicitated team #Dorothy at Tamilnadu Government Secretariat and appreciated our film as an important Cinema that has started a healthy conversation and change in the Society.” He added, “He also took my request to implement strict rules and actions to curb Transphobia in any form and also to have a dedicated Helpline for the transgender community.” The director concluded his post with the words, “Thanks a lot sir. Your words of praise and endorsement to our film means a lot to us..”Tamil Nadu Minister Vanni Arasu calls for more films that challenge social discriminationSpeaking to reporters after the meeting, Vanni Arasu praised the filmmakers for addressing deep-rooted social issues. “It is encouraging to see directors come forward to break caste structures,” he said, as reported by Nakkheeran, adding that 'Dorothy' had opened up a new conversation about the transgender community. He also expressed hope that more films would explore such subjects.'Dorothy' has received appreciation from several members of the film industry, including directors Mani Ratnam and Shankar. Superstar Rajinikanth had also met the team and praised their work. With the latest meeting bringing attention to the director’s request, the discussion around 'Dorothy' has moved beyond cinema to the need for stronger protection and support for transgender people.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: What happened in Juventus Women's last victory against Como 1907?
articles.summary: The Women's First Team are back in Serie A Women action after the international break, which saw Italy beat Belarus 3-1 on aggregate over two legs in a World...
articles.body:
The Women's First Team are back in Serie A Women action after the international break, which saw Italy beat Belarus 3-1 on aggregate over two legs in a World Cup qualifier.

The Bianconere's Matchday 3 game sees them host Como 1907 in Biella. This is actually the very first match in Serie A between the two teams, with Como being promoted from Serie B during the summer.

The teams have met once before already this season, though, so let's take a look at what went down.

You don't have to cast your minds back very far to remember what happened when Juventus last beat Como 1907. It came just two months ago, when Juventus travelled to Lombardy for a Serie A Women's Cup group match.

There has been much excitement around Como 1907 and the squad they have put together for their first Serie A campaign, but Juventus asserted their dominance with a 2-0 victory.

Whilst it was a closely contested match, Alba Redondo gave the Bianconere the lead in the 25th minute. She reacted quickest to a loose ball in the box to open the scoring.

There was a feeling that the match could have gone either way, but in the 79th minute, Remina Chiba showed great awareness to head in when a cross bounced back off the post.

That victory set Isaac Guerrero's team on a journey that would eventually lead them to retain the Serie A Women's Cup title, remaining the only team that has managed to win the tournament.
